[b]The Goodman Act[/b]

The Government of the United States of Oceanica has officially enacted the Goodman Act, declaring a temporary neutral state in the country to maintain the stability of the economy, remain neutral in all wars, and protect the supply chain as global tensions rise. The Federal Assembly of the Grand House approved the enactment of the Goodman Act with the assistance of relevant departments in the country. The Act establishes a revised neutral state to protect the country's economic interests while keeping it out of direct war.

The Goodman act rest assured that international trade relations would continue as per usual business practices.  New regulations would be added to the trade relations to strengthen the country's economy and reduce geopolitical threats.  Trade relations with non-allied countries that are in the midst of war would be reduced by 80% in strategic and sensitive areas. Trade relations with allied countries would continue, but government-level trade would be reduced to 25% of the total capacity to focus on the country's stability and usage of resources. The actions are precautionary in nature to protect the long-term continuity of the Oceanican economy and industry.

[b]Economic and Technological Development Update[/b]

The country of Oceanica is in the midst of rapid economic and technological development due to increased cooperation between the public sector and the private sector. 
Recent economic policies have resulted in increased efficiency in the areas of research, development, and production of key technologies such as advanced manufacturing technology, artificial intelligence technology, energy infrastructure technology, and next-generation defense technology.

The country is also witnessing increased industrial output as domestic production is ramping up to support local demand and export expansion. The private sector in Oceanica is developing a new set of high-performance technology products that are gaining competitiveness at the global level. With the strategic investments made in the area of innovation development, the country is accelerating the transition from the research and development phase to the commercial and industrial usage phase.

The USO is also focusing on developing its technology supply chain to make the country more independent in terms of technological development and to maintain its position as one of the global technology leaders. With the ongoing international conflicts, Oceanica is maintaining its stance of neutrality and continuing its economic cooperation and development projects.

[b]Statement on Dalesburg International Airport Terrorist Attack[/b]
[i]The Democratic Republic of New Westmore has reason to believe that the incident which occurred in Dalesburg International Airport two days ago was a terrorist attack backed by the Sealiphate of Irocco.

Two days ago, an airliner took off from Dalesburg International Airport carrying a large quantity of contraband arms and drugs. This contraband was subsequently dropped over Dalesburg during its flight around the city. The motive as to why remains unclear, but Federal Police investigators have proposed that this was done as a tactic to intimidate or to incite a call to arms against authorities. After the airplane returned to the airport, the occupants on board attempted to escape authorities, and blew up their airplane on the runway as they fled to destroy the evidence. A shootout occurred after, resulting in the deaths of four of our officers and the arrests of two of the men on board. We are still searching for the third occupant of the aircraft. We suspect that the man on the run may have been the pilot in control. We are encouraging anyone with information about this man to come forward as soon as possible - the sooner we get him into custody, the safer our nation will be from this threat of terrorism.

We demand an explanation from the Sealiphate of Irocco. If no explanation is provided, or if our suspicions are vilified, we will push for sanctions and for further action to be taken against them, which may include a total embargo, removal from the Corridor Treaty or condemnation from the ICJ. We will also be completely terminating our bilateral relations with the Sealiphate until further notice - any Westmorians inside Irocco are encouraged to leave before the end of the month.

We strongly condemn any act of terrorism against our nation, and we will not take kindly to foreign actors maliciously interfering with the order of our society. Let it be known that we will not bow to terror regimes that seek to oppress us or disrupt our way of life.[/i]

[b]White Devil[/b]
Grant collapses onto his sofa and turns on the TV.

A press conference from Lundy. Something about the deal gone wrong. [i]Oh joy,[/i] Grant thinks to himself. [i]What does this rube have to say now?[/i]

As he watches, Grant raises his eyebrows. [i]Wait a minute, they think it's a terrorist attack? What the hell did Hammad and Ahmed tell them?[/i]

Grant turns off the TV and sighs. Well, his airplane might be gone for good, but at least he still has his life. Although now, the cops will probably be looking twice as hard for him because someone decided to spin a great big lie about what they were actually doing.

Grant walks to his kitchen and scoffs as he makes a coffee. [i]"Ha, a terrorist attack. OK mate, whatever you say."[/i]

He turns the kettle on. The sound of boiling water begins to fill the room. As he looks outside, he quietly appreciates the beauty of the world just outside his window. Birds are singing, flowers are blooming, the sun is shining, the city's hustle and bustle quietly rumbles in the distance. Just another day in New Westmore.

As the kettle starts to whistle, Grant picks it up and pours the water into his mug. All of a sudden, his kitchen window shatters as something small flies through it.

It takes Grant 3 seconds to figure out what has been tossed through his window.

It's shaped like a pineapple. It's coloured in a greenish-gray paint. It has a small metal top with a hole in it.

It's a grenade.

Grant drops his mug and tries to run, but he's simply too late.

The grenade explodes, mulching Grant's back into a fine red mess. The explosion damages his stove, and before Grant can fall to the ground, his entire house erupts into a giant orange fireball as the gas main to his home ignites.

In just 3 short seconds, Grant is reduced to a corpse burned and mauled beyond recognition. Outside, his assailant drives away in a black car, muttering the oath of the gang that he wronged on the night he ran away like a coward.

[i]Nobody f*cks with their Brothers and gets away with it.

Not even the devil can escape the righteous wrath of God.

Now and forever, Brothers 4 Life.[/i]
